name: checkR6
title: Returns true, or a message, after testing whether the value is an R6 object with the requested slots

origin.description: Returns true, or a message, after testing whether the value is an R6 object with the requested slots.
origin.usage: checkR6(x, classes = NULL, ordered = FALSE, cloneable = NULL, public = NULL, private = NULL, null.ok = FALSE)

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: Value under test. A Python int is an R integer and a Python float is an R double.

arguments.name: classes
arguments.text: Class names the object must inherit.

arguments.name: ordered
arguments.text: When true, the class names must appear in this order.

arguments.name: cloneable
arguments.text: When true the object must be cloneable, and when false it must not.

arguments.name: public
arguments.text: Names required in the public slots.

arguments.name: private
arguments.text: Names required in the private slots.

origin.details: Returns true, or a message, after testing whether the value is an R6 object with the requested slots.
origin.value: True, or a message describing the first failure.
origin.example:
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(checkmate))
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(data.table))
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(tibble))
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(R6))
obj <- R6Class("Bar", public = list(a = 5), private = list(b = 42))$new()
fn <- function(x) x
print(checkR6(obj, "Bar", public = "a"))
